scope: Exact local BAAI/bge-m3 embedding runtime and admission package only; not owner review, generation-model approval, private benchmark execution, baseline seal or A9 closure.

findings: Post-hash inference-time model mutation was not initially revalidated.
A pre-existing output symlink could initially be overwritten.
The local evaluator was initially placed in a dependency group installed by normal --all-groups CI.
A same-byte symlink retarget during inference could initially evade a plain post-inference byte rehash.
Runtime reports initially omitted exact dependency-lock and verifier provenance.
Literal <REPO> redaction markers initially made the stored JUnit XML invalid.

limitations: Library offline mode and local_files_only were verified, but OS-level network isolation was not.
BGE-M3 is an embedding model and cannot satisfy the generation half of the real-provider benchmark.
No human owner approval, private candidate-pack review, real production-path benchmark or baseline seal is represented by this review.
